nativeAdaptations.rail: 72px compact rail, sidebar follows the native user preference; 344px is only an absent-variable fallback. The theme does not override the native resizer. Native 40px icons at 48px cadence, no zoom. Only native SVG base path becomes an 8px rounded rectangle; badge cutouts remain intact. Flat selected tab 56 × 48px at left -8px/top -4px, radius 8px, relative positioning/isolation, no ring. Expanded folder track 56px centered at 8px with neutral index tone; closed preview index tone and Frost folder glyph. Native folder variable remains 48px alongside 40px avatars; native header negative margins remain intact for tooltip anchors. No ad hoc tooltip offsets.
nativeAdaptations.history: Reuse native base grid page area with display-contents wrappers; title/trailing controls retain titleBar. History observed inline before channel name at correct header height; margin 12px 8px, header reservation 112px. Notice rows own layout. No fixed coordinates or anchor positioning. Main voice header reserves112px through exact headerWrapper_cb9592 > subtitleContainer__49508 > headerBar__49508 hierarchy; nested titles unchanged. Two native open/close cycles observed.
nativeAdaptations.account: Preserve native fitInAccount nameplate behind identity and controls; keep combined sidebar 344px and account on one row at narrow widths.
nativeAdaptations.voice: One container covers connection status and four actions; status minimum 40px, actions 40px high without horizontal padding, icon flex basis 20px. Active actions use nord14-derived fill/border/text. Eleven licensed pinned SVGs remain vendored; ten masks active (five header/rail, five voice). Signal asset unused. Native 16px network-quality SVG with zero padding preserves Fine/Average/Bad paths. Direct native button nth-of-type(1), (2), (3) and soundboard aria mapping preserve hidden spans; active video overrides video-off. No new runtime fetch/package.
nativeAdaptations.controls: Modern native button/radio/checkbox/focus/notification roles map to Nord tokens; modern switches use Frost tracks and dark thumbs. One exact local legacy-switch checked query targets direct hiddenVisually > input:checked to the indicator; nord10 track !important overrides Discord inline color. Checker permits at most one query and validator whitelists its exact selector; no global ancestor :has().
nativeAdaptations.channelList: No extra bottom margin; native panel reservation already protects the list. Lower channels reappeared in native 1280 × 720 evidence.
nativeAdaptations.pinnedEntries: Transparent, borderless square entries with a thin separator only between siblings; populated native pins panel observed.
nativeAdaptations.callChat: At <=1200px an open voice wrapper keeps a full-width call at max(284px, 52%) height; exact general-sibling portal selectors place connected chat below in remaining height. DM/thread panels unaffected. Named call container at <=560px supplies two-row control-grid fallback. Native stacked state observed at 1101 × 801.
nativeAdaptations.menuLabels: Native menu labels wrap with normal whitespace and break-word overflow wrapping.
nativeAdaptations.avatarGeometry: Portrait, decoration, reply and font-size geometry are native. Do not reintroduce isolated width/left overrides on the avatar.
nativeAdaptations.virtualRows: Native category and channel heights remain authoritative for virtual scroll calculations. Colours and unread semantics remain themed.
nativeAdaptations.memberRows: Transparent resting background; restrained hover and focus-within. Native personal banners and presence preserved.

components.name: Selected channel
components.description: Illustrative native selection treatment. Not Discord runtime evidence.
components.css: .ds-channel{display:block;min-height:36px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--sibnight-selected,color-mix(in srgb,#81a1c1 28%,color-mix(in srgb,#2e3440 90%,color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in srgb,#2e3440 55%,#5e81ac) 45%,#000))));color:var(--sibnight-heading,#eceff4);font:650 16px Figtree,'gg sans',sans-serif;text-decoration:none}.ds-channel:hover{background:var(--sibnight-hover,color-mix(in srgb,#4c566a 40%,transparent))}.ds-channel:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sibnight-focus,#88c0d0);outline-offset:-2px}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-channel:focus-visible{outline-color:Highlight}}

components.name: Composer surface
components.description: Illustrates the single painted outer surface and transparent editable layer. Production preserves native attachment and command controls.
components.css: .ds-composer{min-height:56px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--sibnight-control,color-mix(in srgb,#434c5e 60%,color-mix(in srgb,color-mix(in srgb,#2e3440 55%,#5e81ac) 45%,#000)));color:var(--sibnight-foreground,#d8dee9)}.ds-composer textarea{display:block;width:calc(100% - 24px);min-height:24px;margin:0;padding:16px 12px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:400 16px/1.5 Figtree,'gg sans',sans-serif;caret-color:var(--sibnight-focus,#88c0d0);resize:vertical}.ds-composer:focus-within{outline:1px solid var(--sibnight-focus,#88c0d0)}.ds-composer textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--sibnight-focus,#88c0d0);outline-offset:-2px}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-composer:focus-within,.ds-composer textarea:focus-visible{outline-color:Highlight}}

narrative.overview: A quiet reading room for long Discord discussions and voice sessions. Dark Polar Night planes frame the conversation; Frost marks useful actions and focus. Figtree and a coherent outline icon family keep the interface readable and recognizable. This documents the standalone numbered-module implementation, superseding the rejected shared Sibnight architecture.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous conversation canvas with quiet supporting indexes.
One composer surface and an integrated account area.
Flat tonal separation, restrained borders and limited popup depth.
Native content, status, accessible labels and interaction semantics.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Preserve native unread, mention, mute and connection distinctions.

rules.name: The Continuous Canvas Rule
rules.body: Separate functions without ornamental containers around the conversation or every message.

dos: Reuse existing tokens; prefix new project tokens with --sibnight-.
Preserve native labels, content, focus, unread state, profile identity and voice semantics.
Edit declared source modules and regenerate outputs in explicit build order.
Distinguish source inspection, synthetic fixtures and observed runtime states.
donts: No decorative nested cards, blanket rounded panels, glow, blur or global motion.
No new remote resources, telemetry or unreviewed code.
No partial class selectors, global ancestor :has() queries or transitions of all properties. Only the exact local legacy-switch checked-state query is permitted.
No current visual validation claims from mockups, static checks or historical screenshots.
Do not publish private screenshots or conversation content.
